_comment: What luvus-panes reads: one Luvus session's agents, tasks, leases and panes over UHP.
_session_comment: Which Luvus server session to read. `luvus session list` names the ones on this machine; `default` is the one `luvus` starts on its own.
_refresh_comment: Maximum idle delay in seconds; agent status events wake a full read sooner.
